HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAVINDER DUDEJA  ORDER % 08.08.2025 CRL.M.A. 23142/2025 EXEMPTION Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
1. This is a petition under Section 528 of BNSS read with Section 227 of the Constitution of India for quashing of FIR No. 832/2015 under Section 498A/406/34 IPC registered at P.S. Nihal Vihar.

2. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that both parties entered into an amicable settlement before the mediation centre, Tis Hazari Courts and in terms of the settlement, they agreed to obtain divorce by mutual consent and get the FIR quashed.

He further submits that in terms of the settlement, respondent no.2 has received Rs.9.50 lacs from the petitioners but now she is not cooperating and is making additional This is a digitally signed order.
